_about: The shot encyclopedia: every kind of shot the studio can build, as a recipe the builder can run. Each entry says what the shot is for, how it is built (framing, where people stand, the camera, the motion, the sound), which promises it keeps and which it cannot, and what was measured. `build` is what /build fills in when a person picks the entry; `camera` names a post move the studio performs (never a sentence the engine is asked for).

families.title: Coverage
families.blurb: The shots every scene needs before it needs anything else.

families.title: Camera moves
families.blurb: Done by the studio after the render, so the measured camera equals the requested one.

families.title: People
families.blurb: Framings of one or two people from their packs: whole figures on the plate's ground, faces from the portrait view.

families.title: Place
families.blurb: The place alone, alive: nobody in it, the camera doing the work.

families.title: Dialogue
families.blurb: Lines through the voice packs; the picture holds the speaker.

families.title: Motion beats
families.blurb: In-place actions that pin (turn, crouch, look up); walks stay on LTX.

families.title: Reveals and transitions
families.blurb: Shots whose point is what changes between the first and the last frame.

shots.title: Establishing wide
shots.purpose: Set the place. Nobody in it; the picture is the plate itself, alive.

build.action: the place as it is, alive

keeps: the place stays the place (drift check)
nobody appears (people check; the rig takes over if the engine keeps adding them)
cannot: a camera move by prose - use a post move
shots.measured: LTX drifts 9-17% on a static prompt; stabilise brings it to 1.00

shots.title: Wide with the people in it
shots.purpose: Who is where. Whole figures on the plate's ground, footing checked.

build.action: stand in the scene, looking out at it

cannot: asking them to stand still - LTX may walk them
shots.measured: two-shot composite about six minutes; walks appear on 'talking quietly' prose

shots.title: Medium on one person
shots.purpose: The person, knees up, the place readable behind.

build.action: stands in the scene, looking out at it, a slow breath

cannot: the engine's push-in without stabilise
shots.measured: drift 39-72% on some seeds regardless of the sentence

shots.title: Close-up
shots.purpose: The face, large, from the first frame. Composed from the portrait view on a window of the plate.

build.action: looks off, then back, a slow breath; the face held in the frame

keeps: the face is the pack's portrait (relight drift 1-6%)
cannot: a second person in frame
'turns toward' - the whole head turns away
sound from the engine (a face fills the frame: silent) - the place's sound is borrowed
shots.measured: composed in 18-20 s; photographic close-ups -48 to -60 dB before the borrow

shots.title: Two-shot, medium
shots.purpose: Two people, both whole, both lit like the place.

build.action: stand together, talking quietly, looking out at the place

keeps: both identities (second character as a relit layer)
cannot: 'stand' - they may walk toward camera (LTX law)
shots.measured: 336 s from the page for two variants and a retry

shots.title: Insert - a detail of the place
shots.purpose: Something small and true: a lamp, a rope, wet leaves. The detail plate, moving slowly.

build.action: a close detail of the place

keeps: the plate itself when the engine keeps adding people (rig fallback)
shots.measured: the rig's push measured 1.117 for 1.12 asked

shots.title: Push in
shots.purpose: Close the distance slowly: attention narrowing. Done by the studio.
keeps: the push is exactly the amount asked (post move 1.14; measured within 1%)
cannot: a push beyond ~1.4 without softening (it is a crop)
shots.measured: post push 1.15 on a take that drifted 1.16 measured 1.31 - the two compound

shots.title: Pull back
shots.purpose: Open the frame: from the detail to the place. Starts tight, ends at the whole frame.
keeps: the end frame is the whole render; nothing is invented
cannot: pulling wider than the render

shots.title: Pan
shots.purpose: Travel across the place, left or right, at a slight zoom so there is room to travel.
keeps: 12% of the frame, eased, measured 0.119 for 0.12 asked
cannot: a pan wider than the room the zoom gives

shots.title: Tilt
shots.purpose: Down from the sky to the ground, or up from the feet to the face.

shots.title: Orbit (2D stand-in)
shots.purpose: A gentle lateral drift with a counter-zoom and a hair of roll: the flat film's arc.
cannot: true parallax - the plate is flat

shots.title: Handheld
shots.purpose: A frame that breathes: small correlated shake on a static shot.
keeps: the shake is the same every time for the same seed

shots.title: Locked off (stabilised)
shots.purpose: A frame that truly does not move. The engine's drift is measured and cropped out.
keeps: zoom 1.00 +-0.03 after stabilise (measured 0.986 from a 1.163 drift)
cannot: the price is the end frame's crop everywhere
shots.measured: a 'locked off on a tripod' sentence changed nothing (3 of 3)

shots.title: A line, on camera
shots.purpose: One person says one line. The picture holds them; the voice pack says the words.

build.action: looks at the camera and speaks

keeps: the words are exactly the line (voice pack)
cannot: lip sync to the pack's words (the mouth is the engine's)
the engine's own speech (wrong or absent - measured on 26 clips)
shots.measured: VO pass about a minute; native track ducked to 0.12

shots.title: A line, in close-up
shots.purpose: The face large, the line in their voice.

build.action: listens, then speaks, the face held in the frame

cannot: 'turns toward' (the head turns away)
shots.measured: 456 s from the page to a voiced pick

shots.title: Reaction
shots.purpose: The listener, not the speaker: a look, a breath, no words.

build.action: listens, a small change in the eyes, a breath

shots.title: Turn in place (pinned)
shots.purpose: A body turn that holds the ground: both ends chosen, H3 interpolates.
keeps: the figure's feet and scale (held geometry)
cannot: a pin below the change floor - Make renders on LTX instead, never forces
shots.measured: pins from whole figures judged yes; forced pins judged no

shots.title: Crouch (pinned)
shots.purpose: Down to the ground and hold.
keeps: whole figure from the first frame (only whole views are placed)
cannot: a crouch from a knee-cropped pack - repaired first

shots.title: Look up
shots.purpose: A small lift of the head; the place answers with light.
cannot: pinning (below the floor) - LTX prose instead
shots.measured: anime close-up held the look through the take

shots.title: Walk toward camera (LTX)
shots.purpose: A figure closes distance. Never pinned: H3 regenerates the scene for a walk.
cannot: the place through the walk (drift is likely)
shots.measured: H3 pinned walks regenerated a riverside path from frame 0, twice

shots.title: Reveal by pulling back
shots.purpose: Start on the detail, end on the whole: the place revealed around the person.
keeps: the end frame is the composed wide

shots.title: Reveal by tilting up
shots.purpose: Feet to face, or ground to sky.

shots.title: Cutaway
shots.purpose: Leave the people for one detail, then come back. The detail plate on a slow push.

shots.title: The place at night
shots.purpose: The night plate, lanterns and water moving, nobody in it.
shots.measured: empty shots fell to the rig when the engine kept adding people

shots.title: Time passes
shots.purpose: The place's own plates - day to dusk, dusk to night - dissolved into one shot with a slow push. Nothing generated; the light changes, the geometry cannot.

build.action: the day turns in the same place

keeps: the place as its plates show it - deterministic, the same every time
cannot: identical geometry: the plates share a description, not a camera, so the dissolve reads as a soft cut between two views of the place
people in it
a time the place has no plate for
shots.measured: 12 places have two or more wide plates; a night-to-late-night dissolve with push 1.06 measured 1.056; the boats sit differently in the two plates

shots.title: Dutch tilt
shots.purpose: The frame leans as the shot goes: unease arriving. Done by the studio (roll 0 to 8 degrees at a zoom that hides the corners).
keeps: the roll is exactly the degrees asked (measured 7 for 8)
cannot: a roll beyond ~15 degrees without heavy crop

shots.title: Whip pan
shots.purpose: A hard fast pan in the middle of the shot - the frame still, then gone, then still. Cut on it.
keeps: the travel is a fifth of the frame in a third of a second
cannot: true motion blur (a crop has none)
shots.measured: asked 0.25 at zoom 1.16, measured 0.16 - the zoom's room caps the travel

shots.title: Over the shoulder
shots.purpose: The listener's back and shoulder large in the foreground, the speaker facing us behind. Two packs, two layers: the near one in its back view.

build.action: faces the other and speaks quietly

keeps: both identities (the near one by costume and hair)
cannot: the near figure's face (it is turned away by design)
relighting the near figure (a relit back view came back as a face - it is tinted instead)
shots.measured: third build: the back and shoulder large in the near left, the speaker facing us behind (the near figure is sized 1.8x the frame - the depth pass cannot see the ground behind the shoulder); the first build relit the back view into a face, the second kept him at the speaker's distance

shots.title: Point of view
shots.purpose: What the person sees: the place alone, a slow handheld drift, nobody in frame.

build.action: the place as it is, alive

keeps: the drift is the same every time for the same seed

shots.title: Walk and talk
shots.purpose: Two people walking toward us, one line in the first person's voice. The walk is LTX's; the words are the pack's.

build.action: walk toward the camera together, talking

cannot: the place through the walk (drift likely)
lip sync
shots.measured: two-shot walks read as walks; the place drifted 67-83% on some seeds

shots.title: Montage of details
shots.purpose: Three short inserts of the place, cut together: the studio builds each as a detail plate on a slow push.

shots.title: Low angle (from the ground)
shots.purpose: The person seen from low, monumental. Composed at a near stand, then tilted up by the studio.

build.action: stands over the camera, looking down at it

cannot: a true low camera (the plate's horizon is fixed)
